gui.icheme.fluid.power_on.hint: Switch off, then press Apply. Flow stops and settings are retained.
gui.icheme.fluid.power_off.hint: Switch on, then press Apply. Resume with the retained settings.
gui.icheme.fluid.fans_on.hint: Stop the fans, then press Apply. Air still rises through the bundle by natural draught, a quarter of what the fans blow.
gui.icheme.fluid.fans_off.hint: Start the fans, then press Apply.
gui.icheme.fluid.burners_on.hint: Put the burners out, then press Apply. Both coils of the heater follow.
gui.icheme.fluid.burners_off.hint: Light the burners, then press Apply. Both coils of the heater follow.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.off.hint: No controller: the bypass share, or the fans, stay as set. Press to hold the outlet temperature instead, then Apply.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.outlet_temper: The bypass, or the fans, hold the outlet at the set point, one slice late after a change. Press to hold a duty instead, then Apply.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.duty.hint: The bypass, or the fans, hold the heat moved at the set duty, at most what the unit can move. Press for manual, or an exchanger's ratio, then Apply.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.ratio.hint: A control valve on this side's feed holds it at the ratio times the other side's feed, read by a flowmeter on that feed. It needs the lines: press Check lines. Press for manual, then Apply.
gui.icheme.fluid.check_lines.hint: Checks the exchanger's control lines as an assembly: a bypass (inlet tee, control valve, outlet tee) for a temperature or duty, a feed valve and the other feed's flowmeter for a ratio. Once complete, the control works the real valve; the status line says so.
gui.icheme.fluid.theme.hint: The process screens' control panel, light (a grey door, red LED meters) or dark (an anthracite door, amber LED meters). Click to switch; kept in icheme-client.toml.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_control.hint: The controller sets the side's bypass, or an air cooler's fans, at each slice or step from its last state. It cannot do more than the unit moves with no bypass or full fans, nor less than with the bypass fully open or the fans still: the status line then says LIMITED.
gui.icheme.fluid.low_limit.hint: A cooled outlet never goes below this, whatever the control asks: against ice, crystals and wax downstream. The status line says LOW LIMIT while it holds. A blank field sets none.
gui.icheme.fluid.bypass.hint: The share of the flow that passes outside the tubes and rejoins at the outlet. It does not change the side's pressure drop.
gui.icheme.fluid.fans_speed.hint: The fans' speed the controller set, as a share of full speed. Still fans leave natural draught, a quarter of full air.
gui.icheme.fluid.control.hint: The unit drawn as a flowsheet with its streams, and its built-in control: what this side holds, the set point, and what acts now.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_side.hint: Open this side's screen. Each side keeps its own control.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.off.title: Manual
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.duty.title: Duty
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.ratio.title: Feed ratio
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.ratio.line: A feed valve holds it to the other feed
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.firing.title: Fire to the set point
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_mode.firing.line: Sets the burners, up to each coil's duty
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_field.low_limit.hi: A cooled outlet never goes below this, whatever the control asks: against ice, crystals and wax downstream. Blank: off.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_effort.burners: Burners at %s %% of the coil's duty
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_effort.feed_valve: This feed is %s times the other
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.bypass.not_v: The real bypass is not checked yet: the internal bypass controls. Press Check lines.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.bypass.check: The real bypass lacks %s parts: the internal bypass controls.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.bypass.unmet: The real bypass valve waits for its flowmeter.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.ratio.not_va: The ratio's lines are not checked yet: it holds nothing. Press Check lines.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.ratio.checke: The ratio's lines lack %s parts: it holds nothing.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.ratio.unmete: The feed valve waits for its flowmeter.
gui.icheme.fluid.lines_note.ratio.comple: The feed valve holds the ratio.
gui.icheme.fluid.pool_note: The pool has no control of its own: the tubes hold the kettle's duty. Open Tubes to set it.
gui.icheme.fluid.reader_note: Read only: you cannot change this unit's control here.
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_status.ratio_waiti: The feed ratio waits for its lines
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_status.firing_shor: Firing to %s: the outlet is %s below it
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_status.firing_most: Firing to %s: the coil fires at its most
gui.icheme.fluid.heat_status.boiling: Boiling with %s kW from the tubes
gui.icheme.fluid.status.low_limit: Low limit: the outlet is held at %s
gui.icheme.fluid.status.duty_short: Duty insufficient: the outlet is %s below the set point
gui.icheme.fluid.stream.hint: Each inlet and outlet of the unit, with its temperature, pressure, flow, phase split and composition. Contents: what the node holds.
gui.icheme.fluid.line_temperature.hint: The temperature of the stream this pipe carries, as a temperature gauge on it reads. With no flow, the last stream seen.
item.icheme.pipeline_sight_glass.install: Right-click a process pipe to install
item.icheme.pipeline_sight_glass.recover: Returned when broken or changed into a bend or junction
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.size: Lays pipe of internal diameter %s m
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.lay: Right-click a start, then an end, to lay a line between them
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.cancel: Shift + right-click while laying to cancel
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.dismantle: Shift + right-click a pipe to remove that block
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.configure: Shift + right-click elsewhere to set the size
item.icheme.pipe_laying_tool.apart: A laid line joins only its own ends, never a pipe it runs beside
message.icheme.pipe_laying.started: Start: %s. Right-click the end; Shift + right-click to cancel
message.icheme.pipe_laying.dropped: Laying cancelled: too far from the start
message.icheme.pipe_laying.rack_carries: This rack carries pipes: remove them with the laying tool first
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.lane_c: A rack carries no junctions: start the branch outside the rack
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.face_t: Another pipe already leaves the rack through that face
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.lane_s: That size does not fit the rack there: a rack pipe continues at its own width, leaves no wider, and enters at least as wide as the pipe it leaves
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.transi: A pipe beside a rack pipe keeps two connections at most, and no fitting or gauge
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.slot_t: No room for this size in that slot of the rack: aim at a free slot on the tier
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.nozzle: That nozzle takes no pipe this large: aim at it to see the largest it fits
message.icheme.pipe_laying.not_allowed: You cannot lay or remove pipe here
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.fittin: A pipe with a fitting takes no branch here
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.juncti: That pipe already has four connections
message.icheme.pipe_laying.anchor.device: That device connects only along its line
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.start_o: The start cell is occupied, or its rack has no room for this size
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.end_occ: The end cell is occupied, or its rack has no room for this size
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.same_fa: Both ends meet the same face
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.too_lon: No route within 128 blocks of pipe
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.joints: The line would join its end twice
message.icheme.pipe_laying.route.one_slo: A one-block pipe takes one slot: aim the end at the start's slot
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.configure: Shift + right-click away from pipes to set the target diameter
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.apply: Right-click a process pipe to resize it
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.apply_line: Shift + right-click a process pipe to resize its whole line
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.line_resized: Line of %s pipes set to %s m
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.line_too_long: Line longer than %s pipes: not resized
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.nozzle_too_sma: A nozzle on this pipe takes no %s m pipe: not resized
item.icheme.pipeline_tool.lane_too_narro: A rack lane on this line is too narrow for a %s m pipe: not resized
gui.icheme.pipeline_tool.paint.primary.h: Edit the primary colour: the pipe, its bends and its rack lanes
gui.icheme.pipeline_tool.paint.secondary: Edit the secondary colour: the flanges
gui.icheme.pipeline_tool.paint.bare.hint: No paint: the edited part keeps the steel's own grey, as hand-placed pipes do
gui.icheme.pipeline_tool.paint.custom.hi: Any colour as #RRGGBB: it paints the edited part once six digits are typed
gui.icheme.pipeline_tool.paint.unpainted: Bolts, valves and fittings keep theirs
gui.icheme.column_preset.tia_juana_resid: Tia Juana Light atmospheric residue (VDU feed)
item.icheme.pressure_control_valve.insta: Right-click a straight pipe to install. Aim along it to set flow direction.
item.icheme.pressure_control_valve.one_a: Only one accessory fits a pipe section.
item.icheme.pressure_control_valve.recov: Breaking the pipe returns this accessory.
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.categor: Drums, columns, storage tanks and spheres, adsorbers and cyclones
Heat transfer: exchangers, reboilers, air coolers and fired heaters
Pumps, compressors, ejectors and steam turbines
Stirred, trickle-bed and ebullated-bed reactors, the FCC converter and the delayed coker
Boilers and gasifiers for coal, biomass or waste
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.equipme: Stands on a slotted skirt, its outlet line leaving through the opening towards you; place up to 6 side connections
Lies on two saddles, along or across the constructor's facing; place up to 6 side connections

Trays and platforms on a skirt, the bottoms leaving through the skirt's port; feed and bottoms face you, reflux and pumparounds your right, draws, steam and the reboiler return your left, each turning where crowded (Nozzles turns them by hand). Build its exchangers, reboiler and ejector as units and run the pipes; or import a column calculator's design

An open storage tank for stabilised liquids (crude, products, water) on a concrete ringwall, its pontoon roof floating on the liquid: two bottom nozzles and an overflow at the fill height, all towards you. A stair wound round the shell climbs to the gauger's platform; the wind girder carries a walkway round the top

A pressure sphere for gases and volatile liquids on column legs at its equator: the vapour outlet on top, the liquid outlet from the bottom pole out towards you. A stair wound round it climbs to the top platform

A shell-and-tube exchanger (TEMA AES) on two saddles: the tube side in at the bottom of the channel towards you and out at its top, the shell side in on top and out underneath. Size its shell and tubes; condensers, coolers and heaters are exchangers
A kettle on two saddles: the heating medium through the tube bundle (channel towards you), liquid fed underneath, vapour leaving on top and the product over the weir at the back head
A bank of forced-draught bays, side by side in parallel and one behind the other in series, fans blowing up through each bundle; one inlet on top at the front, one outlet underneath at the back
An ejector standing on its own frame: suction towards you, motive steam on top, discharge downwards; sized by its suction

An overhung process pump (API 610 OH2) on its baseplate and plinth: suction towards you along the shaft, discharge up over the casing, the motor behind a coupling guard; sized by its discharge. Drawn only: the one-block pump pumps

A balanced-opposed compressor (API 618) on a steel table: 2, 4 or 6 double-acting cylinders on both sides of its frame, a suction bottle over each side's cylinders fed by one suction header over the machine (suction on top) and a discharge bottle under them joined by one discharge header (discharge towards you), the motor behind; sized by its bore. Drawn only: the one-block compressor compresses

A fired heater (API 560) with a round radiant section on fireproofed legs, burners firing up through its floor, the convection section, breeching and stack on its roof; the convection coil in at the top of its front header box and out at its bottom, the radiant coil in under the roof and out over the floor (pipe the crossover between them), fuel gas under the floor, all towards you. Both coils fire to one set point; the burners need no fuel yet

A fired heater (API 560) with a box radiant section and a hipped roof on fireproofed legs, rows of burners firing up through its floor, the convection section along its roof and a stack every 15 m; longer than 24 m it is a twin cell, two radiant sections of half its length either side of an aisle under one convection section. The convection coil in at the top of its front header box and out at its bottom, the radiant coil into the left header box near its top and out of the right one over the floor (a twin's through manifolds across the aisle; pipe the crossover between them), fuel gas under the floor, all towards you. Both coils fire to one set point; the burners need no fuel yet
A jacketed reactor with a top-mounted agitator drive, hung from lugs on its operating deck: charge and vapour on the top head, product through the bottom valve, coolant in and out of the jacket
1 to 4 temperature-swing adsorber beds on skirts, joined by valved headers top and bottom: feed in and product out while the other beds regenerate on hot gas
A heavy-wall hydroprocessing reactor of 1 to 4 catalyst beds on a skirt: oil and hydrogen down from the top elbow, cold hydrogen quench between the beds, effluent out through the skirt

A residue hydrocracker whose catalyst bed is kept expanded by the ebullating pump under its bottom head, recycling liquid from above the bed; fresh catalyst added on top and spent catalyst drawn off on line
A horizontally split multistage compressor (API 617) driven by a motor through a step-up gear on a concrete table: suction and discharge down through the table, the lube-oil console at grade
A turbine-generator set on its plinth: steam in through the trip-and-throttle valve, exhaust up into a lower-pressure header, a gear and a generator
A turbine-generator set on a concrete table, its exhaust falling into the surface condenser underneath: steam in, cooling water through the condenser, condensate and air extraction out
1 to 4 high-efficiency cyclones in parallel on a frame: dusty gas in through the side inlet, clean gas out of the top, solids down through a rotary airlock

A side-by-side fluid catalytic cracker in its structure: feed injected into the riser, the reactor and stripper on top of it, the regenerator burning the coke off in air, the two joined by slide-valved standpipes
1 or 2 pairs of coke drums on a concrete table with their structure and cutting derricks: one drum fills with hot residue while its partner is steamed, quenched and its coke cut out by water jets
A boiler burning solid fuel in a fast-fluidized bed, the solids caught in hot cyclones and returned to the furnace: feedwater in, steam out, ash drained below, the flue gas to its own stack

A pressurised refractory-lined gasifier (HTW type): solid fuel through lock hoppers into a bubbling bed blown with oxygen or air and steam, the syngas cleaned in a cyclone and cooled in a steam-raising cooler
A stoker boiler burning solid fuel on a moving grate: fuel fed from day bins across its front, ash dropped into a drag-chain trough, feedwater in and steam out, the flue gas to its own stack

A Lurgi dry-bottom gasifier in its gasifier house: lump coal through the coal lock on top, oxygen and steam up through the turning grate, ash out through the ash lock, the raw gas washed in its wash cooler
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.shell.h: Shell inside diameter, 0.5 to 2.5 m in 0.25 m steps; the bundle fills it, about 75 D² m² of tube surface per metre of tubes
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.tubes.h: Tube length in whole metres, at least three bundle diameters and 2 m: up to 12 m for an exchanger, 10 m for a kettle
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.shell_b: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
Tube bundle diameter, 0.5 to 2 m in 0.25 m steps; the kettle's shell is 1.6 times it, leaving the vapour space over the boiling pool
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.kettle_: Height of the kettle's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.bay.hin: Width across the tubes × length from header to header, 1.5 to 3 m by 3 to 6 m: only bays whose fans can cover 40 % of the bundle (API 661)
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paralle: Bays side by side sharing the flow, 1 to 6: an inlet manifold over their first headers and an outlet manifold behind their last join them
Bays one behind the other, 1 to 4: the flow passes each in turn, crossover spools join each back header to the next front header
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.bundle_: Height of the tube bundle's bottom above the ground, 3 to 16 m, leaving the fans and their motors room underneath
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.suction: Suction nozzle diameter, 0.05 to 0.8 m in 0.05 m steps; the ejector is 8.3 times as long; one of 0.2 m or less hangs on a single post
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.dischar: Height of the discharge flange above the ground, 1 to 16 m
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.pump_di: Discharge nozzle diameter, 0.05 to 0.6 m in 0.05 m steps; the suction is one size larger, the impeller, casing and motor follow. Up to 0.4 m an overhung pump, larger an axially split one with both nozzles to the sides
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.bore.hi: Cylinder bore, 0.15 to 1.2 m in 0.05 m steps; the stroke, cylinders, bottles, headers, steel table and motor follow
Cylinders, 2 to 10, in opposed pairs on both sides of the frame so their forces balance
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.foundat: Height of the steel table under the frame; at least as high as keeps the discharge bottles 0.3 m over the ground
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.radiant: Radiant section diameter, 2.5 to 12 m in 0.5 m steps
Radiant section height in whole metres, 1.5 to 2.75 diameters (API 560), 4 m at least and 20 m at most (vertical tubes reach about 18 m)
Radiant section width, 4 to 12 m in 1 m steps; the walls stand 1 m higher than it is wide
Radiant section length in whole metres, 1.2 widths and 6 m at least, up to 48 m; above 24 m a twin cell, two sections of half the length side by side; one stack per 15 m of a cell
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.heater_: Height of the floor above the ground, 3 to 16 m: the burners hang under it and need room to stand beneath them
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.surface: Outside surface of the bundle's tubes: about 1,260 D² tubes of 3/4 inch on a 1 inch pitch, 75 D² m² per metre of tubes
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.kettle_: The kettle's shell over its bundle (1.6 times), and the outside surface of the bundle's tubes
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.bay_fac: The bank's bundle face between its headers, which the air crosses, and the fans under it
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.ejector: From the steam chest to the diffuser's exit: 8.3 suction diameters
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.pump_fl: Liquid at 3 m/s in the discharge; the shaft power at a 100 m head of water and 70 % efficiency
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.displac: Swept volume of the double-acting cylinders per hour at the frame's speed; the gas delivered is less by the volumetric efficiency
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.heater_: Heat to the process: the radiant tubes at 35 kW/m² on average, the radiant section taking 70 % of the duty (API 560 practice)
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.axis.hi: Along (lengthwise) or across (crosswise) the constructor's facing
Import the design saved in the nearest column calculator within %s blocks: its trays, feed, side draws, pumparounds, steam, diameter and components. A column is built from an imported design only.
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.import_: Import a design from a column calculator to build a column
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.trays.h: Trays of the imported design as the column calculator counts them, the condenser and the reboiler included; 0.6 m apart, the column's height follows from them
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.feed.hi: The feed tray of the imported design, counted from the top as in the column calculator: tray 1 is the condenser
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.diamete: Inside diameter of the shell in 0.5 m steps: 0.5 to 10 m for a drum, up to 15 m for a column
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.tangent: Straight shell between the two head seams (tangent to tangent), 1 to 64 m. Each 2:1 head adds a quarter of the diameter
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.skirt.h: Height from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m, at least enough to enclose the head. The default leaves about 1 m under the head for the bottom outlet line, which leaves through the skirt's opening; slots show the inside
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.boot.hi: A water boot near the front end, inboard of the front saddle: the feed enters at the far end, free water settles into the boot and leaves by the drain at its bottom, while the oil flows on over a baffle to the liquid outlet, which moves from the front head to the bottom between the front saddle and the front head where it has room. The saddles rise until the drain's pipe has a block above the ground. A drum too short to keep the boot clear of both saddles has none
The side the bottom outlet's line leaves the skirt on, as you look from the constructor: front, left, back or right. Its port in the skirt turns with it, the slots keep to the other three sides and the anchor chairs stand between them. A trickle-bed reactor's effluent turns only where its other parts leave room: to the left its quench line gives way to the front, and to the back or the right, whichever the ladder from the ground leaves free. Click to turn it
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.saddles: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 1 to 16 m. The two saddles sit an eighth of the length in from each head seam
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.forward: Blocks from the constructor to the vessel's near side, 1 to 16; 1 puts it right next to the constructor
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.right.h: Moves the vessel sideways, in blocks: to your right as you look from the constructor towards it, to your left when negative
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.up.hint: Raises the vessel's ground above the constructor's level, in blocks; lowers it when negative
Height of the vessel's top above its ground, and its length along the axis over both heads
Inside volume of the shell and heads, which is the reservoir's capacity, and the outside area of the shell and heads
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.cells.h: Blocks the vessel takes: shell cells carry the drawn wall, interior cells are the space inside it
Build needs every cell of the ghost free; blocks in the way are outlined red in the world
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.connect: Inlets and outlets on the drum's shell, up to 6: the side each faces, its height (a lying drum's place along it) and its offset across the shell; a lying drum's water boot and its drain; the side a standing drum's bottom outlet leaves its skirt
Which side connection the rows below edit
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.faces.h: The side the nozzle faces as you look from the constructor: front (towards you), left, back, right, and on a lying drum top and bottom. Click to turn it
Height of the nozzle's centre line above the vessel's ground, m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.column_: The column's side nozzles: each stands by its tray and takes a side by itself (feed and bottoms face you, reflux and pumparounds your right, draws, steam and the reboiler return your left), turning to another where a nozzle, a ladder or a platform is in the way. Turn any to a side of your choice
Which side nozzle the rows below show, in the column's order: reflux, feed, pumparounds, reboiler return, side draws, steam, bottoms
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.column_: The side the nozzle faces as you look from the constructor. Auto: the side it takes by itself. Click to choose the front, then the left, the back and the right, then Auto again; a nozzle you turn keeps that side or has no row
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.nozzle_: Height of the nozzle's centre line above the column's ground, m: the row by its tray where it found room
How many side nozzles face a side you chose. All auto lets every one take its side by itself again
The side the nozzle tries first by itself; where that is taken it turns to a side at 90°, then to the opposite one
Where the nozzle stands in the column, trays counted as the column calculator counts them (tray 1 is the condenser)
%s has no free row by its tray
Build waits until every side nozzle has a row by its tray: turn a crowded one to another side, or back to Auto
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.along.h: Distance of the nozzle's centre line from the end of the front head (where the liquid outlet leaves, or with a boot the end away from it), m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
Moves the nozzle off the centre line across the shell, in whole blocks: a hillside nozzle, its pipe parallel to a centred one. The further out, the smaller the largest pipe
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.add.hin: Places a new side connection where it meets nothing: a standing drum's as high as it goes, a lying drum's nearest its front head. Up to %s
Takes the selected side connection away
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.connect: Any pipe connects: the nozzle's neck and flange take the connected pipe's size, whatever it is, up to 0.8 m
A side connection is an inlet, or an outlet drawing all phases together; the top outlet draws vapour first, the bottom outlet liquid
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.h: Colours of the metal parts: primary for the body, secondary for the structure, from the palette or your own
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.b: Edit the primary colour: shell, heads, cladding and a unit's casings
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.s: Edit the secondary colour: skirt, saddles and steelwork
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.p: RAL colours seen on process plants; click one to paint the edited part
Any colour as #RRGGBB: it paints the edited part once six digits are typed
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.d: The configured colours (icheme-common.toml, equipment; built-in RAL 9006 on RAL 7031)
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.paint.u: Pipes, flanges and rails keep theirs
Pipes, flanges, nozzles, gratings, handrails, motors and actuators keep their own colours
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.clash.h: Build waits until no side connection meets another nozzle, the manway, the boot, a saddle or the ground, each at its largest pipe and flange
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.clash.g: Connection %s has no room above the ground
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.stirred: Inside diameter of the shell, 1 to 4 m in 0.2 m steps; the jacket, heads, agitator drive, nozzles and operating deck follow
Height of the shell between its heads, whole metres from 0.7 to 2 diameters (1 m at least); the jacket covers it
Height of the bottom valve's outlet above the ground, 1 to 3 m; the operating deck stands on its columns at the lugs above it
Volume of the shell and its two heads; the motor about 4 kW times the volume in m³ to the power two thirds, as on DIN glass-lined reactors
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.adsorbe: Inside diameter of each bed vessel, 1 to 4.6 m in 0.2 m steps; the bed depth (2 diameters, 2.5 to 9 m), the lines, valves, headers and top platform follow
Bed vessels in the row, 1 to 4: one adsorbs while another regenerates, so a set runs without a stop from 2 beds
Height of the skirts under the beds, 2 to 4 m (3 m at least from 3.8 m): room under each bed for its bottom line, its flanges and the unloading nozzle
Adsorbent in each bed: the bed's cross-section times its depth of 2 diameters (2.5 to 9 m)
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.tank.di: Inside diameter of the shell, 4 to 40 m in whole metres; the roof's pontoon ring is a tenth of it
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.tank.sh: Height of the shell, 4 to 24 m; the roof floats up to 1 m under its top, the fill height, where the overflow stands
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.tank.he: The shell's cross-section times its fill height: the roof floats on the liquid, so the tank keeps no vapour space
Inside diameter of the sphere, 4 to 24 m in whole metres; the legs, about one for each 4.5 m of its equator, follow
Height of the sphere's bottom above the ground, 2 to 8 m: room for the liquid outlet's line under it
The sphere's volume, a sixth of pi times its diameter cubed: it holds gas under pressure, as a drum does
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.trickle: Inside diameter of the shell, 1 to 5 m in 0.5 m steps. It sets the wall (a twentieth of it), each bed's depth (1.2 times it and 1 m, 7 m at most) and the nozzles
Catalyst beds, 1 to 4, one over the other with a cold hydrogen quench zone and a platform between each two. A single bed's quench line trims the inlet instead
Height from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m: at least half the diameter and 1.5 m, and from 2.5 m across enough for the effluent line to turn under the head to its port 1.5 m up
The catalyst the beds hold, each bed filling the shell's cross-section to its depth
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.ebullat: Inside diameter of the shell, 2.5 to 6 m in 0.5 m steps. It sets the wall (0.055 of it), the ebullating pump under the bottom head, its recycle lines and the two catalyst vessels
Straight shell between the head seams, 4 to 7 times the diameter in whole metres; about 5 times is usual. The expanded catalyst bed fills about 0.6 of it
Height of the open skirt from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m: at least enough for the pump and its canned motor under the head, with 1.2 m under the motor to lower it out
The liquid the ebullating pump returns under the grid to keep the catalyst bed expanded, about 4.5 cm/s up the reactor's cross-section, and the pump's shaft power against about 3.5 bar
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.centrif: Impeller diameter, 0.3 to 1.5 m in 0.1 m steps; the casing (1.9 times as wide), bearings, nozzles, gear, motor, table and lube-oil console follow. The flow grows with its square
Impellers in the casing, 2 to 9; each lengthens the casing by 0.35 of the impeller diameter and adds head and shaft power, so the gear and motor grow with them
Height of the operating deck on the concrete table, 4 to 7 m in whole metres; at least 4 m, 5 m from a 0.5 m impeller and 6 m from 0.8 m, so the suction line's elbow and strainer fit under the slab
Inlet flow and shaft power scaled from a 0.65 m, four-impeller Elliott 32M4 (33,000 m³/h, 2.5 MW) with the impeller's area and the impellers; the speed keeps the impeller tips at 245 m/s
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.cyclone: Cyclone body diameter, 0.3 to 2 m in 0.1 m steps; Stairmand's high-efficiency proportions set the inlet, gas outlet, cylinder (1.5 diameters) and cone (2.5). From 1.2 m a roof walkway with a caged ladder
Cyclones in parallel, 1 to 4, a diameter and 1.5 m apart on common inlet and outlet headers; several drop their dust through their airlocks into one screw conveyor

Height of the cone's dust outlet flange above the ground, up to 8 m in whole metres; at least as high as hang the dipleg or hopper, the airlock and the conveyor, with the solids outlet a block over the ground
Air through all the cyclones at 20 m/s in their inlets; the cut size is the mineral dust (2.5 g/cm³) caught half the time (Lapple). Smaller cyclones catch finer dust
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.steam_t: Outside diameter of the casing's exhaust end, 0.6 to 3 m in 0.1 m steps, about 5 MW per square metre of it; the steam chest, trip-and-throttle valve, gear and generator follow, and on the condensing set the condenser and its table

Turbine stages, 1 to 12; each lengthens the casing by 0.15 of its diameter. One stage is a single-stage turbine with hand valves on its steam chest; more carry 1 to 5 governor valves under a bar-lift bridge
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.condens: Height of the operating deck on the concrete table, in whole metres up to 16; at least 2.4 times the casing and 0.5 m, and 4 m, and as high as hangs the condenser with its cooling-water inlet a block over the ground
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.steam_t: Electrical output of a typical set of this casing (within a factor of two either way) and the turbine's speed, geared down to the 4-pole generator
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.fcc_con: Regenerator diameter outside the shell, 4 to 17 m in 0.5 m steps; its straight shell (1.5 D + 9 m), the feed whose coke it burns, the reactor and stripper, the riser, the standpipes, the slide valves and the structure follow

Riser length from its wye to its end inside the reactor, up to 44 m: 2 to 4 s of contact time. The shortest offered grows with the regenerator, 25 m at 4 m to 36 m at 17 m, so the spent catalyst still falls from the stripper, within 45° of vertical, over the longer run to the larger regenerator's bed

Height of the regenerator's bottom tangent above the ground, up to 14 m, on its concrete table: the lowest offered (8 to 11 m) leaves room for the air line's elbow under the bottom head and keeps both standpipes within 45° of vertical
Fresh feed the regenerator can burn the coke of, in m³/h and thousand barrels a day: its bed's area takes air at 0.6 to 1 m/s, about 50,000 barrels a day at 9.6 m across, in proportion to the area
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.delayed: Coke drum diameter outside the shell, 4 to 10 m in 0.5 m steps; the straight shell (2.5 D + 8 m, 29.3 m at most), the cone, the structure and the derricks follow
1 or 2 pairs of drums in one row, each pair with its switch valve: one drum fills while its partner is steamed, quenched and cut
Height of the drums' bottom flanges above the ground, 8 to 16 m: the unheading valves, the switch deck and the coke chutes hang under the concrete table
Coke %s t a drum, feed %s t/h
A drum's coke bed at 0.85 t/m³ filling the cone and three quarters of the straight shell; each pair fills one drum in 16 h at a coke yield of 30 % of the vacuum residue fed
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.fluidiz: Inside width of the furnace, 3 to 26 m in 1 m steps; its depth (0.65 of the width, 2.5 to 11 m), its height (20 to 45 m), the back pass, the fans, the fuel bins and the steel follow

Hot cyclones in a row on the furnace's rear wall, 1 to 4, sharing 0.85 of the width: only counts where none is wider than 8.7 m or a quarter of the furnace's height and the row fits the furnace's width and 2 m
Height of the grid above the ground, 5 to 8 m: the windbox, the bed-ash coolers and their conveyor stand under it, the feeder floor 4.5 m above it
About 3.3 MW per m² of grid, at most 950 MW: the bed circulates through the hot cyclones, the steam drum and the back pass take the heat, the fans blow the air in and draw the flue gas to the stack

Inside diameter of the gasifier, 1.5 to 6 m in 0.25 m steps; the shell (0.8 m wider), the height between its heads (12 m and 4 diameters), the cyclones (two over 4.5 m), the lock hoppers, the syngas cooler and the structure follow
Height of the vessel's bottom tangent line above the ground, from what the ash screw and the ash lock hopper under it need up to 16 m; the vessel stands on its support ring a third of the way up

About 24 MW per m² of bed (140 MW over a 2.75 m bed): oxygen or air and steam fluidize the bed under pressure, the fuel comes in through the lock hoppers and screws, the syngas leaves through the cyclones and the cooler
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.fixed_b: Inside diameter of the gasifier, 2 to 5 m in 0.25 m steps; the vessel (3.1 times as tall between its heads), the coal and ash locks, the bunker and the gasifier house follow
Height of the ash lock's bottom valve above the ground, 3 to 5 m: its ash chute ends over a truck or a conveyor underneath

The vessel's inside diameter and its height between the heads: a water-jacketed pressure vessel holding a coal bed 3 to 4 m deep at about 30 bar; oxygen and steam rise through it from the turning grate, the jacket raising part of the steam
gui.icheme.equipment_constructor.grate_b: Width of the grate, 2 to 12 m in 0.5 m steps; the furnace (12 to 36 m high), the feeders and the boiler follow: a bi-drum boiler up to 6 m wide, a single drum over a back pass above
Length of the grate from the feeders to the ash drop, 3 to 10 m: sets the furnace's depth, the feeders' stroke and the air plenums under the grate (3 to 5)
Height of the grate above the ground, 3 to 6 m: the siftings hoppers and the drag-chain ash trough stand under it, the firing aisle 1 m below it
%s MW of fuel, %s t/h of steam
Fuel burnt at 1.5 MW per square metre of grate; steam raised at 85 % boiler efficiency, 2.8 MJ for each kilogram from feedwater to superheated steam

gui.icheme.column.pressure_failure: The pressure profile is outside the supported range. Check pressure and column diameter.
gui.icheme.column.solver_failed_hint: No accepted solution. Check the inputs; copy the solver report for detailed evidence.
gui.icheme.column.pressure_drop.hint: Pressure drop per tray interval in kPa. At diameter 0 it sets the uniform profile; at a positive diameter it is the first guess the tray hydraulics correct.
gui.icheme.column.profile_metric.hint: Cycle temperature, pressure, tray pressure drop and phase traffic.
gui.icheme.column.traffic_legend: Teal organic phase / amber vapor / blue steam / violet aqueous phase
gui.icheme.column.profile_click.hint: Click a profile point to inspect its tray.
gui.icheme.column.solve_products: Solve to view product compositions and component flows.
gui.icheme.column.terminal_no_dp: Tray 1 and the last tray have no dP. A pot has zero column dP.
gui.icheme.column.signed_heat: Signed heat: positive in, negative out
gui.icheme.column.copy_report.hint: Copy raw solver diagnostics and numerical evidence to the clipboard.
gui.icheme.column.request_rejected: The server rejected this request. Refresh the column or check its inputs.
gui.icheme.column.invalid_input: Check tray count, feed location and numeric inputs.
gui.icheme.column.invalid_mixture: Add supported components with finite non-negative amounts and a positive total.
gui.icheme.column.invalid_draw: Check draw locations and rates. Total draw must be below total feed.
gui.icheme.column.invalid_steam: Check steam location, superheat and flow. Total steam must not exceed feed.
gui.icheme.column.invalid_pa: Check PA draw/return trays and positive cooling duty.
gui.icheme.column.draw_balance: Draw at tray %s: requested %s kmol/h; internal liquid %s kmol/h.
gui.icheme.column.overview.hint: Edit the column drawing and inspect solver and tray information.
gui.icheme.column.composition.hint: Edit the feed mixture and inspect component flow rates.
gui.icheme.column.results.hint: Inspect accepted profiles, product streams and duties.
gui.icheme.column.diagnostics.hint: Inspect acceptance checks and copy detailed solver evidence.
gui.icheme.column.components.hint: Choose the condenser and the pumps, and save the design that an equipment constructor builds.
gui.icheme.column.condenser.hint: Click to switch the condenser. An exchanger takes the overhead vapour on its shell side.
gui.icheme.column.pump.hint: Click to switch between a standard pump on its base and an In-line Pump fitted on a pipe.
gui.icheme.column.ejector_required: Required: top pressure %s kPa is below 101.325 kPa
gui.icheme.column.kettle_none: None: sump steam strips the bottom
gui.icheme.column.receiver: A lying drum with a boot for the sour water
gui.icheme.column.reflux_line: A tee and the reflux valve, also at a zero reflux ratio
gui.icheme.column.valves: Off-gas, distillate, sour water, feed, bottoms; %s steam and %s draw valves
gui.icheme.column.save_design.hint: Check the column's structure and save this design with its components. The nearest equipment constructor within 16 blocks imports it.
gui.icheme.column.design_saving: Saving the design; awaiting engine update
gui.icheme.column.design_ready: Ready to save: %s trays, %s m diameter
gui.icheme.column.design_saved: Saved: the constructor imports this design
gui.icheme.column.design_differs: The saved design differs: %s trays, %s m diameter
gui.icheme.column.profiles.hint: View temperature, pressure, pressure drop and traffic profiles.
gui.icheme.column.streams.hint: View product compositions and component flow rates.
gui.icheme.column.heat.hint: View accepted tray duties and the column heat balance.
gui.icheme.column.open_folder.hint: Open this client preset folder to edit or add JSON files. Click Refresh after editing.
gui.icheme.column.benchmark_hint: Fixed Holland benchmark. Select its column and mixture templates independently to reconstruct the reference case; other physical edits are not supported by this benchmark.
gui.icheme.column.connections.hint: Choose a connection to add at the selected tray.
gui.icheme.fluid.phase_ratio.generator_h: Equilibrium phase fractions of the published configured feed at its temperature and absolute pressure, including suspended solids in volume/mass mode.
gui.icheme.fluid.phase_ratio.basis_hint: Choose Volume, Mole or Mass percentages for these published phase readings. This does not change composition inputs.
gui.icheme.fluid.volume_capacity.hint: Current fluid volume / maximum reservoir volume, in litres.
gui.icheme.fluid.flow_unit.hint: Switch every flow rate and suction-flow input between per second and per hour. The physical flow setting stays the same.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_flow_unit: Enter a valid flow rate before changing flow units.
gui.icheme.fluid.search: Search by component name or ID
gui.icheme.fluid.crystal.hint: Formed from the fluid in a tank, as dry ice forms from CO2. It grows or melts back only in tanks; pipes, pumps and filters carry and catch it like any solid.
gui.icheme.fluid.waiting: Waiting for the next simulation update.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_composition: Enter non-negative amounts with a positive total.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_number: Enter a valid temperature before changing units.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_input: Check numeric inputs and composition; amounts must be non-negative with a positive total.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_ratio: Max pressure ratio (out/in) must lie between %s and %s.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_solid: Each solid row needs a material ID, size and relative mass share.
gui.icheme.fluid.mixture_loaded: Mixture loaded. Apply changes to update the generator.
gui.icheme.fluid.outlets.hint: Top outlets draw gas first, then the lighter and the heavier liquid phase. Bottom outlets draw the heaviest liquid phase first, then the lighter one, then gas. Side outlets draw all phases together. Inflow through any face is not distinguished.
gui.icheme.fluid.datasheet.hint: Equipment sizes and nozzles: each nozzle's purpose, phase class, direction and largest pipe size.
gui.icheme.fluid.waiting_identity: Equipment is waiting for its world identity.
gui.icheme.fluid.outlet.overflow: Overflow (%s): liquid above the fill height
gui.icheme.fluid.mixture_library: Select a mixture to fill the composition.
gui.icheme.fluid.empty_mixture: Add a component using the search dropdown, or load a mixture.
gui.icheme.fluid.overview.hint: Inspect the most recently delivered process state.
gui.icheme.fluid.composition.hint: Define the generator mixture with relative molar or mass amounts.
gui.icheme.fluid.solids.hint: Edit suspended solids separately from the fluid composition.
gui.icheme.fluid.apply.hint: Queue these controls for the next simulation update.
gui.icheme.fluid.recover.hint: Recover the solids currently captured by this filter.
gui.icheme.fluid.partner_side.hint: Open the passage on the other side of this unit's wall: the one this side exchanges heat with.
gui.icheme.fluid.refresh.hint: Read the mixture files again. Files are refreshed only on request.
gui.icheme.fluid.load_mixture.hint: Load a server preset or compatible client JSON mixture.
gui.icheme.fluid.new_mixture.hint: Clear the fluid composition and add your own components.
gui.icheme.fluid.relative_hint: Amounts are relative; the total need not be 100%.
gui.icheme.common.component_search.hint: Search names or IDs, including partial names and small typos. Use Up/Down and Enter, or click a match. Escape dismisses the list.
gui.icheme.fluid.connections.hint: Readings for every connected pipe. Flow direction is selected automatically.
gui.icheme.fluid.throughput.hint: Transport during the last completed interval. Junctions count outgoing material once. Reversals include transport in both directions.
gui.icheme.fluid.velocity.hint: Accepted volume transported during the last 5 seconds of online simulation time, divided by 5 seconds and this pipe’s bore area. Includes both flow directions and steady-flow replay. Startup, reload and topology changes warm up from zero history; partial intervals use their mean rate. Junctions show the range across connections.
gui.icheme.fluid.gradient.hint: Absolute pressure difference between connected endpoints divided by their pipe length, including elevation effects. This is a path average; junctions show a range.
gui.icheme.fluid.phase_ratio.hint: Phase fractions of accepted passing material over the last completed interval. Stopped/unavailable flow has no passing-phase ratio.
gui.icheme.fluid.phase_ratio.tank_hint: Phase fractions of the contents held in this reservoir in the last published snapshot.
item.icheme.pipeline_shutoff_valve.insta: Right-click a straight pipe to install; starts open.
item.icheme.pipeline_shutoff_valve.toggl: Empty both hands and right-click to open or close.
item.icheme.pipeline_shutoff_valve.strai: Straight pipe sections only; locks the connection axis.
item.icheme.pipeline_shutoff_valve.one_a: Only one accessory per pipe section.
item.icheme.pipeline_shutoff_valve.recov: Breaking the pipe in survival returns the accessory.
item.icheme.pipeline_check_valve.install: Right-click a straight pipe to install; aim along the pipe to set the flow arrow.
item.icheme.pipeline_check_valve.toggle: Empty both hands and right-click to reverse the allowed direction.
item.icheme.pipeline_check_valve.straigh: Straight pipe sections only; locks the connection axis.
item.icheme.pipeline_check_valve.one_acc: Only one accessory per pipe section.
item.icheme.pipeline_check_valve.recover: Breaking the pipe in survival returns the accessory.
gui.icheme.fluid.pressure_unit.hint: Switch all pressures, pressure differences, gradients and pressure inputs between Pa, kPa, bar and MPa. The physical settings stay unchanged.
gui.icheme.fluid.invalid_unit: Enter valid numbers before changing units.
gui.icheme.fluid.table_basis.hint: Switch component percentages, composition entry and flow readings between molar and mass basis. Phase-ratio basis is selected separately.
gui.icheme.fluid.phase_ratio.mole_hint: Mole ratios count fluid molecules and crystalline solids by their conserved component. Custom suspended solids have no molar mass in this model and are excluded.
gui.icheme.fluid.top_pressure.hint: Absolute pressure above the condensed contents, from the published reservoir state. Undefined for an empty reservoir.
gui.icheme.fluid.bottom_pressure.hint: Top absolute pressure plus the existing liquid-and-solid hydrostatic head. No additional pressure setpoint.
gui.icheme.fluid.duty.cooled: The heat the stream gave up across the wall over the last interval.
gui.icheme.fluid.duty.heated: The heat the stream took up across the wall over the last interval.
gui.icheme.fluid.duty.fired: The heat the burners fired into the stream over the last interval.
gui.icheme.fluid.duty_available.hint: The most heat this coil fires with its burners as they are: 35 kW per m² of radiant tube, 15 kW per m² of convection tube, 70 % and 30 % of the heater's duty. A stream that needs more leaves below the set point, and the status line says DUTY INSUFFICIENT. Fuel is not drawn yet.
gui.icheme.fluid.fan_power.hint: What the fans draw while they turn, 1 kW per m² of bundle face at full speed. The network has no electricity to draw it from yet.
gui.icheme.fluid.net_flow.hint: Sum of the reservoir outlet flows: positive is net outflow, negative is net filling.
tooltip.icheme.gauge.configure: Shift + right-click: configure range and units
tooltip.icheme.gauge.install: Aim at a socket and right-click to install
tooltip.icheme.accessory_wrench: Shift + right-click a selected accessory to recover it

item.icheme.fluid_pump.one_accessory: A pipe section accepts one accessory.
item.icheme.fluid_pump.recover: Shift-right-click with the Accessory Wrench to recover.
item.icheme.fluid_compressor.install: Right-click a bare horizontal straight pipe to install.
item.icheme.fluid_compressor.toggle: Aim along the pipe to choose the discharge arrow; right-click installed equipment for controls.
item.icheme.fluid_compressor.straight_on: Install on horizontal straight pipe sections only.
item.icheme.fluid_compressor.one_accesso: A pipe section accepts one accessory.
item.icheme.fluid_compressor.recover: Shift-right-click with the Accessory Wrench to recover.
